title: Mega Man X
subtitle: SNES · Original Mega Man X
intro: Start with the dash, follow the weakness chain, then finish the three return stops. Includes all 16 upgrades and the optional Hadouken.

stages.name: Chill Penguin
stages.tip: Charge while he moves. Wall-jump above his slide, then fire when he stops. Shoot the ice statues before they fill the floor.

items.name: Leg Parts
items.text: Walk into the capsule on the main path, before the Ride Armor section. The dash is required for the route ahead.
items.extra: Unlocks ground dashing and breaking certain blocks with wall kicks.

items.name: Heart Tank
items.text: In the Ride Armor area, jump out onto the roof above. Burn the left igloo with Fire Wave to uncover the heart.

stages.name: Spark Mandrill
stages.tip: Freeze him with Shotgun Ice. Wait for him to thaw before firing again; timed hits can stop each new attack.

items.name: Sub Tank
items.text: Take the lower passage near the start. The tank is behind a wall you cannot enter; throw Boomerang Cutter so its return arc carries the tank to you.

media.credit: Screenshot: Rhody Tobin / HonestGamers; game imagery © Capcom

items.name: Heart Tank
items.need: Boomerang Cutter; or a precise dash wall-jump
items.text: After the first tortoise, look up at the ledge before the downward ladder. Catch the heart with Boomerang Cutter on your return. A dash wall-jump can reach it earlier.

stages.name: Armored Armadillo
stages.tip: Hit him with Electric Spark to strip his armor. Keep firing between his rolling attacks; stay clear when he rebounds from the walls.

items.name: Sub Tank
items.text: Let the first tunneling machine drive right, then drop behind it and enter the recess it was guarding on the left.

media.credit: Screenshot: Rhody Tobin / HonestGamers; game imagery © Capcom

items.name: Heart Tank
items.need: Rapid Buster fire; Fire Wave makes a retry easier
items.text: Drop behind the second tunneling machine and destroy it before it removes the wall under the heart ledge. Fire rapidly into its back, then climb the preserved wall. If you miss, return with Fire Wave for a quicker kill.

stages.name: Launch Octopus
stages.tip: Use Rolling Shield while dodging his missiles. Keep away from the suction whirlpool; wall-jump out of danger before firing again.

items.name: Heart Tank
items.text: Ride the water jet directly beneath the large ship to the surface. Destroy the ship so it sinks through the floor. Follow it down, defeat the serpent by hitting its head or tail, then continue right to the heart.

stages.name: Boomer Kuwanger
stages.tip: Fire Homing Torpedo, then climb away from his dash and grab. Keep moving after he teleports; the missiles track him for you.

items.name: Heart Tank
items.text: At the high outdoor balcony, the heart sits on the ledge above and to the right. Return after defeating Kuwanger and use Boomerang Cutter to pull it down.

stages.name: Sting Chameleon
stages.tip: Boomerang Cutter knocks him out of hiding. Track where he reappears and keep away from the ceiling spikes and his tongue.

items.name: Body Parts
items.text: Before entering the cave, dash-jump onto the cliff above its entrance. Defeat the large green robot by shooting its head; the capsule appears after it falls.

items.text: At the cave entrance, slide down the left side of the pit and break the blocks with wall kicks. The water added after Launch Octopus lets you dash-jump across to the heart.

stages.name: Storm Eagle
stages.tip: Dash into the wind and shoot Chameleon Sting when he lands. Watch the edge of the screen for his diving approach, then jump over it.

items.name: Heart Tank
items.text: Ride the first moving platforms to their highest point. Dash-jump left onto the roof above the starting area.

items.text: Use the moving gun platforms to reach the glass control booth above. Shoot the glass and enter the booth.

items.name: Head Parts
items.text: After climbing the tall metal tower, drop down its far side. Dash-jump right to the fuel canisters, destroy them and follow the opening to the capsule.
items.extra: Breaks marked ceiling blocks; needed for Flame Mammoth’s arm capsule.

stages.name: Flame Mammoth
stages.tip: Storm Tornado interrupts his attacks. Jump when he lands to avoid the floor shake, and stay clear of burning oil.

items.name: Arm Parts
items.text: At the start of the large pickaxe-robot room, jump from the raised platform toward the upper-left ceiling blocks. Break the first block with your helmet, then keep wall-jumping up through the shaft.
items.extra: Enables charged special weapons and the stronger Buster charge.

routes.name: Standard · all upgrades
routes.subtitle: Straight weakness chain
routes.description: All hearts, tanks and armor, with three cleanup stages.

steps.title: Penguin → Mandrill → Armadillo
steps.text: Take the dash immediately; use each reward on the next boss.

steps.title: Octopus → Kuwanger → Chameleon
steps.text: Octopus floods Chameleon’s heart route before you arrive.

steps.title: Eagle → Mammoth
steps.text: Get Eagle’s helmet before attempting Mammoth’s arm capsule.

steps.title: Three return stops → Sigma
steps.text: Collect the missed items and refill four Sub Tanks.

routes.name: Completionist · add Hadouken
routes.subtitle: All upgrades + secret move
routes.description: Follow the standard route, then visit the mine again before Sigma.

steps.title: Finish all eight bosses and 16 upgrades
steps.text: The secret capsule requires your regular collection to be complete.

steps.title: Prepare lives and full health
steps.text: Follow the repeated cliff-visit procedure. Passwords do not retain Hadouken.

steps.title: Enter Sigma’s fortress
steps.text: Zero’s story here is scripted; there is no X2-style rescue-parts route.

extraSections:
Hadouken

Optional, after all eight bosses, eight hearts, four Sub Tanks and four armor parts.

  1. For a reliable attempt, refill health, weapons and Sub Tanks, and stock at least five lives. The respawning bat near the mine entrance can supply extra lives.
  2. Replay Armored Armadillo. From the last minecart jump onto the high ledge above the boss entrance, beside the large health pickup. Visit that ledge, then fall into the pit; repeat four times without a game over.
  3. On the fifth visit, arrive with full health. Enter the capsule that appears on the ledge.
  4. At full health, stand on the ground and input Down → Down-forward → Forward + Fire. Reverse the directions when facing left. Passwords do not save this move.
⤢

Sigma fortress & Zero

Collect and refill before entering. The Maverick rematches are spread through the fortress; reuse the weaknesses above.

  1. Sigma 1: Vile’s first encounter is scripted. After Zero intervenes, defeat Vile with Rolling Shield; if you skipped the arm capsule, Zero supplies the Buster upgrade. His sacrifice cannot be prevented through a collectible route in this game. Bospider: follow the connecting rails to predict its lane, then hit the briefly open red eye with Shotgun Ice.
  2. Sigma 2: use Chameleon Sting against Rangda Bangda’s eyes and nose. Climb clear when the walls close.
  3. Sigma 3: hit D-Rex’s upper half with Boomerang Cutter while avoiding the lower crusher.
  4. Final stage: Shotgun Ice on Velguarder; Electric Spark on Sigma. For the final wolf machine, ride the hands upward and fire Rolling Shield at the head. Charged Buster shots also work.
routeIntro: Both routes use the boss order below. Choose how far you want to take the run.
flowIntro: The numbered route uses weapons already available. A return arrow marks a pickup saved for cleanup.
basicsHtml:
Controls, tanks & returning to stages

Directions use actions rather than controller buttons: Jump, Dash, Fire and Special. Check your control mapping. Heart Tanks increase maximum health; Sub Tanks store excess health collected while your life bar is full. Exit from the pause menu works in cleared stages.
